data.summary: The backend service traffic drop is caused by a misconfiguration in the frontend deployment, which was updated to call the backend on port 9899, while the backend application only listens on port 9898.

root_cause.explanation: The latest revision of the frontend deployment (revision 8, rolled out at 2026-11-16T12:16:40Z) changed the --backend-url argument to point to port 9899 instead of 9898.

evidence.fact: The latest frontend revision 8 changed the --backend-url argument from 'http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9898/echo' to 'http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo'.
The frontend container logs show repeated errors: 'Post http://backend.demo.svc.cluster.local:9899/echo: context canceled'.
The backend container is confirmed to be listening on port 9898: 'Starting HTTP Server.', 'addr': ':9898'.

data.impact: The frontend is unable to communicate with the backend, resulting in a traffic drop on the backend service.

next_steps.action: Revert the frontend deployment to the previous revision to restore the correct backend URL port.
